+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import fnmatch

+
+

+
+

+    "size", "filesize", "ext", "extension", "Ext", "Extension", "date", "time", "mod",
+    "modified", "new", "newest", "age", "old", "oldest", "ch", "changed", "acc",
+    "accessed", "cr", "created", "inode", "type", "none",
+}
+WHEN_VALUES = {"always", "auto", "never"}
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Options:
+    paths: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    long: bool = False
+    grid: bool = False
+    tree: bool = False
+    recurse: bool = False
+    oneline: bool = False
+    all_count: int = 0
+    almost_all: bool = False
+    reverse: bool = False
+    sort: str = "name"
+    dirs_first: bool = False
+    dirs_last: bool = False
+    only_dirs: bool = False
+    only_files: bool = False
+    no_symlinks: bool = False
+    show_symlinks: bool = False
+    classify: str = "never"
+    icons: str = "never"
+    color: str = "never"
+    width: int | None = None
+    level: int | None = None
+    treat_dirs_as_files: bool = False
+    list_dirs: bool = False
+    ignore_glob: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    no_permissions: bool = False
+    no_filesize: bool = False
+    no_user: bool = False
+    no_time: bool = False
+    header: bool = False
+    bytes_mode: bool = False
+    binary: bool = False
+    links: bool = False
+    absolute: str = "off"
+
+
+SHORT_TAKES_VALUE = {"s", "w", "L", "t", "I"}
+
+
+def option_error(msg: str) -> int:
+    sys.stderr.write(f"eza: {msg}\n")
+    return OPTIONS_ERROR
+
+
+def parse_args(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[Options | None, int]:
+    opt = Options()
+    i = 0
+    parsing = True
+    while i < len(argv):
+        arg = argv[i]
+        if not parsing:
+            opt.paths.append(arg); i += 1; continue
+        if arg == "--":
+            parsing = False; i += 1; continue
+        if arg == "-":
+            opt.paths.append(arg); i += 1; continue
+        if arg.startswith("--"):
+            nameval = arg[2:]
+            if "=" in nameval:
+                name, val = nameval.split("=", 1)
+            else:
+                name, val = nameval, None
+            try:
+                i = parse_long(opt, argv, i, name, val)
+            except ValueError as e:
+                return None, option_error(str(e))
+            continue
+        if arg.startswith("-") and len(arg) > 1:
+            try:
+                i = parse_short_cluster(opt, argv, i, arg[1:])
+            except ValueError as e:
+                return None, option_error(str(e))
+            continue
+        opt.paths.append(arg)
+        i += 1
+    if not opt.paths:
+        opt.paths = ["."]
+    if opt.tree and opt.all_count > 1:
+        return None, option_error("Option --tree is useless given --all --all")
+    return opt, 0
+
+
+def need_value(argv, i, flag):
+    if i + 1 >= len(argv):
+        raise ValueError(f"Flag {flag} needs a value")
+    return argv[i + 1]
+
+
+def parse_long(opt: Options, argv, i, name, val):
+    def optional_when(default="auto"):
+        nonlocal val, i
+        if val is None:
+            if i + 1 < len(argv) and argv[i + 1] in WHEN_VALUES:
+                i += 1; val = argv[i]
+            else:
+                val = default
+        if val not in WHEN_VALUES:
+            raise ValueError(f"Option --{name} has no \"{val}\" setting (choices: always, auto, never)")
+        return val
+    def required():
+        nonlocal val, i
+        if val is None:
+            val = need_value(argv, i, f"--{name}"); i += 1
+        return val
+
+    if name in ("help",):
+        print("Usage: eza [options] [files...]\n")
+        raise SystemExit(0)
+    if name in ("version",):
+        print("eza - A modern, maintained replacement for ls")
+        raise SystemExit(0)
+    if name in ("long",): opt.long = True
+    elif name in ("grid",): opt.grid = True
+    elif name in ("tree",): opt.tree = True
+    elif name in ("recurse",): opt.recurse = True
+    elif name in ("oneline",): opt.oneline = True
+    elif name in ("all",): opt.all_count += 1
+    elif name in ("almost-all",): opt.almost_all = True
+    elif name in ("reverse",): opt.reverse = True
+    elif name in ("group-directories-first",): opt.dirs_first = True
+    elif name in ("group-directories-last",): opt.dirs_last = True
+    elif name in ("only-dirs",): opt.only_dirs = True
+    elif name in ("only-files",): opt.only_files = True
+    elif name in ("no-symlinks",): opt.no_symlinks = True
+    elif name in ("show-symlinks",): opt.show_symlinks = True
+    elif name in ("treat-dirs-as-files",): opt.treat_dirs_as_files = True
+    elif name in ("list-dirs",): opt.list_dirs = True
+    elif name in ("sort",):
+        v = required()
+        if v not in SORT_VALUES:
+            raise ValueError(f"Option --sort (-s) has no \"{v}\" setting (choices: name, Name, size, extension, Extension, modified, accessed, created, inode, type, none)")
+        opt.sort = v
+    elif name in ("width",): opt.width = parse_int(required(), "option --width (-w)")
+    elif name in ("level",): opt.level = parse_int(required(), "option --level (-L)")
+    elif name in ("ignore-glob",): opt.ignore_glob.extend(required().split("|"))
+    elif name in ("classify",): opt.classify = optional_when()
+    elif name in ("icons",): opt.icons = optional_when()
+    elif name in ("color", "colour"): opt.color = optional_when()
+    elif name in ("no-permissions",): opt.no_permissions = True
+    elif name in ("no-filesize",): opt.no_filesize = True
+    elif name in ("no-user",): opt.no_user = True
+    elif name in ("no-time",): opt.no_time = True
+    elif name in ("header",): opt.header = True
+    elif name in ("bytes",): opt.bytes_mode = True
+    elif name in ("binary",): opt.binary = True
+    elif name in ("links",): opt.links = True
+    elif name in ("absolute",): opt.absolute = val or "on"
+    elif name in ("follow-symlinks", "dereference", "no-quotes", "git", "no-git", "git-repos", "git-repos-no-status", "extended", "octal-permissions", "context", "stdin", "flags", "modified", "changed", "accessed", "created", "time", "blocksize", "total-size", "hyperlink", "mounts", "smart-group", "numeric", "group", "inode"):
+        if val is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"Flag --{name} does not take a value")
+        # accepted but mostly outside this benchmark area
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown argument --{name}")
+    return i + 1
+
+
+def parse_int(v, source):
+    try:
+        return int(v)
+    except ValueError as e:
+        raise ValueError(f"Value \"{v}\" not valid for {source}: {e}")
+
+
+def parse_short_cluster(opt, argv, i, cluster):
+    j = 0
+    while j < len(cluster):
+        c = cluster[j]
+        rest = cluster[j + 1:]
+        val = None
+        if c in SHORT_TAKES_VALUE:
+            if rest.startswith("="):
+                val = rest[1:]
+            elif rest:
+                val = rest
+            else:
+                val = need_value(argv, i, f"-{c}"); i += 1
+            apply_short(opt, c, val)
+            return i + 1
+        apply_short(opt, c, None)
+        j += 1
+    return i + 1
+
+
+def apply_short(opt, c, val):
+    if c == "l": opt.long = True
+    elif c == "G": opt.grid = True
+    elif c == "T": opt.tree = True
+    elif c == "R": opt.recurse = True
+    elif c == "1": opt.oneline = True
+    elif c == "a": opt.all_count += 1
+    elif c == "A": opt.almost_all = True
+    elif c == "r": opt.reverse = True
+    elif c == "D": opt.only_dirs = True
+    elif c == "f": opt.only_files = True
+    elif c == "d": opt.treat_dirs_as_files = True
+    elif c == "F": opt.classify = "auto" if val is None else val
+    elif c == "s":
+        if val not in SORT_VALUES: raise ValueError(f"Option --sort (-s) has no \"{val}\" setting (choices: name, Name, size, extension, Extension, modified, accessed, created, inode, type, none)")
+        opt.sort = val
+    elif c == "w": opt.width = parse_int(val, "option --width (-w)")
+    elif c == "L": opt.level = parse_int(val, "option --level (-L)")
+    elif c == "I": opt.ignore_glob.extend(val.split("|"))
+    elif c == "B": opt.bytes_mode = True
+    elif c == "b": opt.binary = True
+    elif c == "H": opt.links = True
+    elif c == "h": opt.header = True
+    elif c in "gniSmuUoZOX@M":
+        pass
+    elif c in "v?":
+        if c == "v": print("eza - A modern, maintained replacement for ls"); raise SystemExit(0)
+        print("Usage: eza [options] [files...]\n"); raise SystemExit(0)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown argument -{c}")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Entry:
+    path: Path
+    name: str
+    st: object | None
+    is_arg: bool = False
+
+    def is_dir(self):
+        return self.path.is_dir()
+    def is_file(self):
+        return self.path.is_file()
+    def is_link(self):
+        return self.path.is_symlink()
+    def size(self):
+        return 0 if self.is_dir() else (self.st.st_size if self.st else 0)
+    def mtime(self):
+        return self.st.st_mtime if self.st else 0
+    def ctime(self):
+        return self.st.st_ctime if self.st else 0
+    def atime(self):
+        return self.st.st_atime if self.st else 0
+    def suffix(self):
+        n = self.name
+        if "." not in n or n.startswith(".") and n.count(".") == 1:
+            return ""
+        return n.rsplit(".", 1)[1]
+    def type_char(self):
+        if self.is_dir(): return "d"
+        if self.is_link(): return "l"
+        return "-"
+
+
+def natural_key(s: str, ignore_case=True):
+    if ignore_case: s = s.lower()
+    parts = re.split(r"(\d+)", s)
+    return [int(p) if p.isdigit() else p for p in parts]
+
+
+def cmp_entries(opt: Options, a: Entry, b: Entry):
+    sf = opt.sort
+    def cmp(x, y): return (x > y) - (x < y)
+    if sf == "none": return 0
+    if sf in ("size", "filesize"): r = cmp(a.size(), b.size())
+    elif sf in ("date", "time", "mod", "modified", "new", "newest"): r = cmp(a.mtime(), b.mtime())
+    elif sf in ("age", "old", "oldest"): r = cmp(b.mtime(), a.mtime())
+    elif sf in ("ch", "changed"): r = cmp(a.ctime(), b.ctime())
+    elif sf in ("acc", "accessed"): r = cmp(a.atime(), b.atime())
+    elif sf in ("cr", "created"): r = cmp(a.ctime(), b.ctime())
+    elif sf == "inode": r = cmp(getattr(a.st, "st_ino", 0), getattr(b.st, "st_ino", 0))
+    elif sf == "type":
+        r = cmp(a.type_char(), b.type_char())
+        if r == 0: r = cmp(natural_key(a.name, False), natural_key(b.name, False))
+    elif sf in ("ext", "extension", "Ext", "Extension"):
+        r = cmp(a.suffix() if sf[0].islower() else a.suffix(), b.suffix() if sf[0].islower() else b.suffix())
+        if r == 0: r = cmp(natural_key(a.name, sf[0].islower()), natural_key(b.name, sf[0].islower()))
+    else:
+        an = a.name[1:] if sf.startswith(".") and a.name.startswith(".") else a.name
+        bn = b.name[1:] if sf.startswith(".") and b.name.startswith(".") else b.name
+        r = cmp(natural_key(an, sf[0] != "N" and sf not in (".Name", ".Filename")), natural_key(bn, sf[0] != "N" and sf not in (".Name", ".Filename")))
+    return -r if opt.reverse else r
+
+
+def should_show_name(opt, name):
+    if name in (".", ".."):
+        return opt.all_count > 1 and not opt.tree and not opt.almost_all
+    if name.startswith("."):
+        return opt.all_count >= 1 or opt.almost_all
+    return True
+
+
+def read_entries(path: Path, opt: Options, is_recurse=False):
+    entries = []
+    names = []
+    if opt.all_count > 1 and not opt.tree and not opt.almost_all:
+        names.extend([".", ".."])
+    try:
+        names.extend(os.listdir(path))
+    except OSError as e:
+        raise e
+    for name in names:
+        if not should_show_name(opt, name):
+            continue
+        if any(fnmatch.fnmatch(name, pat) for pat in opt.ignore_glob):
+            continue
+        p = path / name
+        try:
+            st = p.lstat() if hasattr(p, "lstat") else p.stat()
+        except OSError:
+            st = None
+        ent = Entry(p, name, st)
+        if opt.only_dirs and not (ent.is_dir() or (opt.show_symlinks and ent.is_link() and ent.path.is_dir())):
+            continue
+        if opt.only_files and not is_recurse and not ent.is_file():
+            continue
+        if opt.no_symlinks and ent.is_link():
+            continue
+        entries.append(ent)
+    sort_entries(entries, opt)
+    return entries
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries, opt):
+    entries.sort(key=cmp_to_key(lambda a, b: cmp_entries(opt, a, b)))
+    if opt.dirs_first:
+        entries.sort(key=lambda e: not e.is_dir())
+    elif opt.dirs_last:
+        entries.sort(key=lambda e: e.is_dir())
+
+
+def display_name(ent: Entry, opt: Options):
+    name = str(ent.path.resolve()) if opt.absolute in ("on", "follow") else ent.name
+    if opt.classify == "always" or opt.classify == "auto":
+        if ent.is_dir(): name += "/"
+        elif ent.is_link(): name += "@"
+    return name
+
+
+def permissions(ent: Entry):
+    if ent.st is None: return "----------"
+    mode = ent.st.st_mode
+    first = "d" if stat.S_ISDIR(mode) else "l" if stat.S_ISLNK(mode) else "-"
+    bits = ""
+    for who in [(stat.S_IRUSR, stat.S_IWUSR, stat.S_IXUSR), (stat.S_IRGRP, stat.S_IWGRP, stat.S_IXGRP), (stat.S_IROTH, stat.S_IWOTH, stat.S_IXOTH)]:
+        bits += "r" if mode & who[0] else "-"
+        bits += "w" if mode & who[1] else "-"
+        bits += "x" if mode & who[2] else "-"
+    return first + bits
+
+
+def fmt_size(n, opt):
+    if opt.bytes_mode:
+        return str(n)
+    if opt.binary:
+        for unit in ["", "Ki", "Mi", "Gi"]:
+            if n < 1024 or unit == "Gi":
+                return f"{n:.0f}{unit}" if unit else str(int(n))
+            n /= 1024
+    if n < 1000: return str(int(n))
+    for unit in ["k", "M", "G"]:
+        n /= 1000
+        if n < 1000:
+            return f"{n:.1f}{unit}" if n < 10 else f"{n:.0f}{unit}"
+    return f"{n:.0f}T"
+
+
+def render_long(entries, opt, prefixes=None):
+    rows = []
+    prefixes = prefixes or [""] * len(entries)
+    for ent, pref in zip(entries, prefixes):
+        cols = []
+        if not opt.no_permissions: cols.append(permissions(ent))
+        if opt.links: cols.append(str(getattr(ent.st, "st_nlink", 0) if ent.st else 0))
+        if not opt.no_filesize: cols.append("-" if ent.is_dir() else fmt_size(ent.size(), opt))
+        if not opt.no_user: cols.append(os.environ.get("USERNAME") or os.environ.get("USER") or "-")
+        if not opt.no_time: cols.append("-")
+        cols.append(pref + display_name(ent, opt))
+        rows.append(cols)
+    if opt.header:
+        hdr = []
+        if not opt.no_permissions: hdr.append("Permissions")
+        if opt.links: hdr.append("Links")
+        if not opt.no_filesize: hdr.append("Size")
+        if not opt.no_user: hdr.append("User")
+        if not opt.no_time: hdr.append("Date Modified")
+        hdr.append("Name")
+        rows.insert(0, hdr)
+    widths = [0] * max((len(r) for r in rows), default=0)
+    for r in rows:
+        for i, c in enumerate(r[:-1]): widths[i] = max(widths[i], len(c))
+    lines = []
+    for r in rows:
+        if len(r) == 1:
+            lines.append(r[0])
+        else:
+            lines.append(" ".join(r[i].rjust(widths[i]) for i in range(len(r)-1)) + " " + r[-1])
+    return lines
+
+
+def render_names(entries, opt):
+    return [display_name(e, opt) for e in entries]
+
+
+def tree_lines(root: Entry, opt: Options, depth=0, stack=None):
+    if stack is None: stack = []
+    lines = []
+    pref = "".join("│   " if keep else "    " for keep in stack[:-1])
+    if stack:
+        pref += "└── " if not stack[-1] else "├── "
+    if opt.long:
+        lines.extend(render_long([root], opt, [pref]))
+    else:
+        lines.append(pref + display_name(root, opt))
